from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the party as stated in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="The party's role (e.g., 上诉人，被上诉人，再审申请人)")

class AmountInfo(BaseModel):
    label: str | None = Field(description="Description of the amount (e.g., 受理费，赔偿款)")
    value: str | None = Field(description="The amount value including units")
    payer_or_receiver: str | None = Field(description="Who is responsible for or receiving the amount")

class Court(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court")
    level: str | None = Field(description="Level of court (e.g., 中级，高级，基层)")

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="The identifier of the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case (e.g., 民事，刑事，行政)")
    case_numbers: list[str] | None = Field(description="Case numbers mentioned in the document")
    courts: list[Court] | None = Field(description="Courts involved in the case")
    parties: list[Party] | None = Field(description="Parties involved and their roles")
    financials: list[AmountInfo] | None = Field(description="Financial details like fees and compensation")
    verdict_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of verdict (e.g., 维持原判，驳回申请，准许撤回)")
    verdict_summary: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the final ruling")
    unique_markers: str | None = Field(description="Any unique phrases or numbers that distinguish this result")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
